about.bio1: I'm a Software Engineering student in a double-degree Engineering Cycle between 3iL Ingénieurs in Limoges, France and ESPRIT in Tunis, currently in my second year, specializing in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence.
about.bio2: I build multi-agent LLM systems with LangGraph, RAG and MCP, and computer-vision pipelines with YOLO and PyTorch. I also ship production systems: I co-led the full-stack development of an 8-person HR platform built on Spring Boot, OAuth2 / Keycloak and React / TypeScript, spanning 102 REST endpoints.
about.bio3: My work ranges from an autonomous multi-agent farming platform and a 98.83%-accuracy diagnostic ML pipeline to insurance claim automation - always with the same focus: practical systems that pair applied AI with solid engineering foundations.

bullets: Co-led the back-end and front-end poles of SMART HRM AI, an internal HR platform built by an 8-intern team, across a Java 17 / Spring Boot API and a React 19 / TypeScript client.

Designed the platform's security model: OAuth2 / OpenID Connect delegated to Keycloak, a 4-role RBAC model enforced by 104 authorization gates, and AES-256-GCM encryption at rest for salary and bank data.
Built 102 REST endpoints over PostgreSQL with 32 Flyway migrations and MinIO object storage, applying Clean Architecture across 11 modules and 2,072 automated tests (JUnit, Vitest, Playwright).
Owned three AI workstreams: the authorization contract for the OCR document-extraction service, a RAG conversational assistant, and predictive models for absence and staff turnover.
Built a YOLO-based vehicle damage detection and classification pipeline (PyTorch, OpenCV), benchmarked against existing computer vision approaches.
Deployed the model as a FastAPI REST microservice containerized with Docker, reaching 92.9% precision on real-time damage detection.
Developed SmartClaim, a cross-platform Flutter application for insurance claim submission, evidence upload and real-time claim tracking.
Built SolarFlow, a Flutter application for real-time energy production tracking, connected-device management and remote control.
Deployed the application to the App Store and Play Store, and developed the IoT monitoring platform behind it with REST API integration.
